authoritative_actor.derivation: mechanically validate and read winner_actor from the authoritative final actor result; no handwritten substitute is permitted at execution

allowed_changes_from_baseline: change actor family from rolloutu to rolloutu2
add the same data/champion.bin as the continuation network
change zero-based rollout tail field 5 ply_lo from 14 to 0
change zero-based rollout tail field 8 objective from 0 to 3
materialize otherwise default tail fields 36 through 40 as 0,0,0,1,0
append the variant's bound match-value table as tail field 41
candidate_construction.forbidden_changes: every baseline controller field not enumerated in allowed_changes_from_baseline must remain byte-for-byte textually identical

search_plies.semantics: all plies, subject only to existing intrinsic exact-terminal behavior

definition_lock.rule: the definition commit adds exactly the five named new files; its sole-child lock commit adds exactly this one lock file and freezes the definition commit, tree, every definition-file hash, all inherited campaign dependencies, and the authoritative audit bindings before any table build or efficacy match

development.failure_behavior: if neither variant is eligible, select no challenger, skip safety and final, retain the authoritative actor, and do not promote a table
development.purpose: choose exactly one predeclared all-ply objective-3 table variant without using held-out safety or final evidence
selection_rule: then maximize exact combined margin numerator
then use the fixed tie priority PROJECTED_ALL_PLY before RAW_ALL_PLY

strict_isolation: the 17 states, their alternatives, observations, estimates, and verdicts are diagnostic only
none may be a table-build transition, training example, generated probe, development or gate seed, variant-selection input, threshold-selection input, stopping signal, or promotion input
the audit may motivate this already predeclared general method, but may not choose between raw and projected tables or alter any budget, actor, shortlist, criterion, or gate

must_hash: source commit, tree, and source files
compiler, runner, flags, binaries, and build log
both table payloads and parsed controller metadata
mechanically constructed baseline and two candidate actor strings
all commands, seeds, shard matrices, gates, and artifact paths

evidence_contract.raw_stage_barrier: within a stage, every expected immutable raw shard and sidecar must finish and validate before reciprocal results, selection, a gate, or a downstream condition may be computed
required_terminal_contents: definition, lock, execution, plan, workflow, helper, tests, and documentation
raw and projected tables plus table-pair manifest
all raw development shards and sidecars for both variants
both complete development reciprocal results and the mechanical development selection
all raw safety shards and the complete safety result and decision when a challenger exists
all raw final shards and the complete final result and decision only when safety passes
terminal authoritative result recommendation, all SHA256 manifests, and explicit skipped-stage records

automatic_stage_order: complete development matrices for both variants
complete safety matrix for the selected challenger if one exists
complete reserved final matrix only if safety passes
terminal evidence merge and fail-closed recommendation
execution_protocol.launch: one non-forced first-attempt push whose commit adds only the execution JSON to the sealed lock parent

confidence.estimator: mirrored-pair clusters within orientation; combine the two independent reciprocal orientations with equal weight
confidence.meaning: 95% one-sided lower confidence bound, equivalently the lower endpoint of a 90% two-sided interval

forbidden: manual dispatch, rerun, retry, continuation after cancellation, or reuse of any production seed from this or any earlier campaign
inspection or use of partial table-build, development, safety, or final efficacy evidence
optional stopping, adaptive top-ups, sequential peeking, shortlist widening, candidate substitution, threshold tuning, criterion relaxation, or post-lock actor changes
training on, selecting from, gating on, or otherwise converting any user-commented audit probe into promotion evidence
using the held-out safety or final panel to choose between RAW_ALL_PLY and PROJECTED_ALL_PLY
launching the predecessor v1 workflow or creating its absent execution file
automatic branch mutation, checkpoint replacement, table promotion, final_actor_result edit, or repository write from the workflow
claiming promotion when any expected shard, hash, binding, sidecar, exact count, zero-cap check, orientation check, score bound, or margin bound is absent or fails
relaxing any locked criterion for cost, runtime, closeness, a favored audit ply, or any observed outcome

promotion_and_persistence.failure: retain the authoritative 800+800 actor unchanged, persist the terminal result, and do not add or maintain either generated table
promotion_and_persistence.pass: only after independent download and exact verification of all evidence, persist the selected already-canonical table path, persist data/experiments/match_value_objective3_v2_result.json, and mechanically update final_actor_result so its winner actor and asset manifest bind the selected table and unchanged checkpoint

seed_firewall.burn_rule: every production seed in a failed, cancelled, timed-out, or completed attempt is permanently retired; the locked attempt is never rerun
